fact: MACRA said the Malawi Computer Emergency Response Team (MwCERT) currently operates under the regulator, with work under way to make it an independent institution.

The Electronic Transactions and Cyber Security Act (33 of 2016, published 4 November 2016) establishes the Malawi CERT as a unit under the regulator and national coordination base for responding to ICT security threats; the Act commenced on 1 June 2017.

Malawi CERT, through MACRA, publicly alerted individuals, businesses and ISPs to the actively exploited MikroTik RouterOS vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-67276, CVE-2026-86060, CVE-2026-67277) and advised patching.
The article states Malawi CERT is a specialised unit under MACRA and the national focal point for coordinating cybersecurity incidents and threat responses.
Macra says it has established the Cyber Security Emergency Response Team as the hub for receiving, detecting and tracking local and international threats.
Macra's director general says Malawi has a National Cyber Security Strategy.
